# Trim guide (X, S, SE, Off-Road, PRO-4X)

## Summary

[Partial] Verify bumper cutout shape then install Westin license plate light housing with included components. [t31]

[Partial] Install the Frontier LE trim bezel onto a late model Xterra dash with its switch carrier. [t229]

Install Wet Okole Seat Covers and verify passenger side snugness. [t455]

[Partial] Clean plastic pieces with Dawn soap, then sand and apply adhesion promoter before two or three light coats of finish paint. [t596]

Apply a high heat engine paint to the wheels after ensuring a good primer is used. [t855]

Remove existing silver trim from high traffic areas and apply two coats of dark paint. [t443]

## Tips & gotchas

- This kit includes bulbs, hardware, electrical connectors, mounting screws, and an insert. [t31]
- [Partial] Note that the standard Xterra dash only has 3 switches; this panel adds two more slots. [t229]
- [Partial] Verify with customer service whether your specific seats have plastic trays before ordering, as this can affect fitment. [t455]
- [Partial] Use adhesion promoter before applying the topcoat. [t596]
- Apply 2-3 light coats of finish paint. [t596]
- Consider painting the entire interior silver pieces to match a new custom look. [t443]
- Use this method to hide scratches on the console or change interior aesthetics. [t443]
- Use Plasti-Dip as an alternative method for covering or modifying interior trim. [t443]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Skipping the initial soap wash to remove road oils [t596]
